# COR002 `interface-implicit-typing`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An interface body has no `implicit none`.

## Why

An interface body is a separate scoping unit: it does not inherit the `implicit none` of the module
or procedure that contains the interface block. Dummy arguments left undeclared in the body are
typed implicitly, and the interface then disagrees with the procedure it describes.

## Reported

```fortran
interface
  subroutine callback(x)
    real :: x
  end subroutine callback
end interface
```

## Preferred

```fortran
interface
  subroutine callback(x)
    implicit none
    real, intent(inout) :: x
  end subroutine callback
end interface
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR002] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR002` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
